mentions.name: Unnamed in-browser encrypted sharing tool
mentions.description: An unreleased file and message sharing tool, similar to ClosedLinks, that performs encryption in the browser, in chunks, to avoid memory limitations in some browsers, and uses in-browser gzip compression to keep file sizes down and speed things up. The author has also prototyped, but not pursued, a browser extension offering client-side encryption for form fields on any site.
mentions.source_excerpt: I've been working on similar my self. Not released yet, haven't had the time recently.
